observation_summary: EMILY RSI: ArXiv full-paper HTML, per-source stats, mark 3 roadmap items complete; PRRJECT_FATBABY: earnings-calendar committed, earningscal tests
actions_taken: Three improvements to EMILY: (1) ArXiv full-paper HTML extraction via arxiv.org/html/{id}; ArXivSource.MaxFullText=10 fetches top 10 papers per batch with 1s polite delay; fetchArXivFullText extracts <article> element, strips HTML, falls back to abstract on 404; stripHTML handles script/style blocks, HTML entities, block tags; 7 new tests. (2) Per-source stats: CollectionStats.PerSource map[string]int64 tracks collected docs by source name; CollectorPipeline.perSource with perSourceMu; processOne increments on write. (3) Roadmap updated: reddit-collector, wikipedia-collector, quality-scorer marked complete with notes; arxiv-collector notes updated. EMILY commit 1b6aa79. PRRJECT_FATBABY: committed untracked earnings-calendar pipeline and earningscal package (built but never committed); added 8 earningscal tests covering ExtractDate/ExtractPeriod/ExtractBeforeMarket/MakeID; added guidance-watcher and earnings-calendar to .gitignore. Commit 3a9d60d.
notes: All tests pass. arxiv-collector roadmap item remains in_progress: body_quality criterion (< 5% raw LaTeX) needs real corpus verification, but HTML extraction now provides full-text as the primary source. Earnings-calendar binary is ready to run but needs EDGAR/prwatch data in var/ dirs. The earningscal.Store is already wired into signalapi via EarningsCal field.
